description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Fill_Array', which manages a sequential array of fill styles for use in image graph rendering, allowing addition, reset, and retrieval of fill styles and colors.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Fill_Array
classes.description: A class that manages a sequential array of fill styles for image graph rendering, supporting adding styles and colors, resetting, and retrieving fill styles.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the fill style array to the initial position.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a fill style object to the array, optionally with an ID.

methods.name: addColor
methods.description: Adds a color value to the fill style array, optionally with an ID.

methods.name: _getFillStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the next fill style in sequence, or by ID, handling objects and fallback to parent method.
